data.one_liner: Cross-platform Firestore type-safe reference and document wrapper.
data.what_it_does: Provides type-safe helper wrappers for Cloud Firestore references and documents. Allows writing organized code with support for cross-platform access.
use_when: You want type-safe operations on Cloud Firestore documents and collections.
You need structured pagination and stream helpers for Firestore data.
avoid_when: You prefer using the official cloud_firestore API directly without any wrapper abstractions.
You are not using Firebase/Cloud Firestore in your project.
strengths: Enforces stronger typing for Firestore documents and collections.
weaknesses: Adds an abstraction layer over the official cloud_firestore package.
Requires learning a custom API for document and collection references.
data.setup_notes: Requires initializing Firebase using firebase_core and configuring cloud_firestore.

alternatives.name: cloud_firestore
alternatives.why_pick_it: Official plugin providing direct access to Firestore without wrappers.
